hook: Google Gemini now pulls your Drive files into human review.
what_happened: Google Gemini with Connected Apps enabled can automatically retrieve personal Drive files or Gmail messages and send them to human reviewers, even without @ tags.
why_it_matters: It means personal content you discuss can be seen by humans, so privacy expectations change.
what_to_do: Avoid connecting your apps to Gemini Apps if they contain confidential information you wouldn't want a reviewer to see.
the_catch: The retrieval is probabilistic, so it may not happen every time.
caption: Google Gemini can automatically pull personal Drive files and Gmail messages into human review pipelines. Private or exposed?
alt_text: The slides explain that Google Gemini may retrieve personal Drive and Gmail data and send it to human reviewers, note the probabilistic nature, and advise not connecting confidential apps.
